name: autohodl
description: Set up autoHODL scheduled USDC savings on Solana. Includes process_solana_action — a generic tool to sign and broadcast any Solana Action from an AI agent.
instructions: Use autohodl_lookup to check if a wallet has autoHODL configured. If not, instruct the user to send `/start <walletAddress>` to the @autohodl_bot on Telegram, then return here. Once registered, confirm the savings frequency and amount, then call process_solana_action with the authorize Action URL to sign the Token.approve and activate savings.
